## Release checklist

- [ ] Included work items are linked and satisfy their Definition of Done
- [ ] `preview` CI and required checks pass
- [ ] Preview smoke tests pass
- [ ] Database changes and rollback steps are documented
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are current
- [ ] No unresolved Critical or High security finding lacks an approved exception
- [ ] Required approvals are present and review conversations are resolved
- [ ] Merge using a **merge commit**, never squash or rebase
- [ ] Tag the resulting `main` commit with the stated version
- [ ] Publish release notes and versioned images
- [ ] Run and record Release smoke tests
